summary: Testing iteration 15: Code quality refactoring (localStorage removal, secret removal from test files, agent.py complexity reduction). All 35 backend tests pass. Core auth flows confirmed working. One critical frontend bug found: DashboardPage and UygulamalarPage admin detection broken. Test file bugs fixed (3 assertions corrected in test_auth_user.py).

ui_bugs.issue: Admin session not detected on dashboard. Checks `data.role === 'admin'` but /auth/me returns `{user: {role: 'admin'}, type: 'admin'}`. Should be `data.user?.role === 'admin'` and `setAdminUser(data.user)`. Admin logs in via /admin (cookie set) but navigating to dashboard shows 'Giriş Yap' button instead of 'Yönetim Paneli'.

Same bug as DashboardPage - `data.role === 'admin'` should be `data.user?.role === 'admin'` and `setAdminUser(data.user)`. Admin button 'Yönetim' doesn't appear on Uygulamalar page when admin is logged in.

action_items: Fix DashboardPage.js line 95: change `data.role === 'admin'` to `data.user?.role === 'admin'` AND `setAdminUser(data)` to `setAdminUser(data.user)`
Fix UygulamalarPage.js line 124: same fix as DashboardPage.js — `data.role === 'admin'` → `data.user?.role === 'admin'` and `setAdminUser(data)` → `setAdminUser(data.user)`
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.js and UygulamalarPage.js: admin detection uses `data.role === 'admin'` but /auth/me returns `{user: {role}, type}` - admin button never shows after admin login on these pages. AdminPanelPage.js was correctly fixed in iteration 14 but these two files were missed.

test_auth_user.py hardcoded defaults in os.environ.get() calls still expose credentials: os.environ.get('TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD', 'As537273') - password is still in source code as default. Consider removing defaults and requiring env vars.

auth.py /auth/logout: only clears session_token cookie but admin may have admin_token cookie set. Admin logout from admin panel does not clear admin_token cookie (POST /auth/logout only deletes session_token). Consider adding admin_token cookie deletion.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (admin login, user login, user panel, admin panel PASS; admin button detection on Dashboard/Uygulamalar FAIL)

seed_data_creation: test_auth_user.py registers a new TEST_ user per test run (cleaned up by random UUID)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core auth cookie migration is working. Admin login via /admin sets admin_token httpOnly cookie. User login via /auth sets session_token cookie. localStorage tokens (token, admin_token, session_token) are all removed - only app_user remains for UI. Admin panel APIs (/admin/stats, /admin/app-users, etc.) work with cookie-only auth. The only bugs are in DashboardPage.js and UygulamalarPage.js where admin detection checks data.role instead of data.user.role. Once fixed, the admin button should appear on dashboard when admin is logged in.

rca_of_issue.bug: Admin detection broken on Dashboard and Uygulamalar pages
rca_of_issue.root_cause: /auth/me returns {user: {email, role, ...}, type: 'admin'} for admin users (see routers/auth.py lines 107-108). Both DashboardPage.js (line 95) and UygulamalarPage.js (line 124) check data.role === 'admin' but data.role is undefined - the role is nested at data.user.role. AdminPanelPage.js was correctly fixed in iteration 14 to use data.user?.role but these two pages were not updated in that fix.
rca_of_issue.fix: In both DashboardPage.js and UygulamalarPage.js, change: `if (data.role === 'admin') setAdminUser(data)` to `if (data.user?.role === 'admin') setAdminUser(data.user)`
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Login via /admin as admin. 2. Navigate to / or /uygulamalar. 3. Admin panel button does NOT appear despite cookie being set.
